=== typescript
// @leetvim id=690 slug=employee-importance lang=typescript
// 690. Employee Importance (Medium)
// https://leetcode.com/problems/employee-importance/

// Definition for Employee.
class Employee {
    id: number
    importance: number
    subordinates: number[]
    constructor(id: number, importance: number, subordinates: number[]) {
        this.id = (id === undefined) ? 0 : id;
        this.importance = (importance === undefined) ? 0 : importance;
        this.subordinates = (subordinates === undefined) ? [] : subordinates;
    }
}
// @leetvim end: delete this line to keep your changes above

    public var importance: Int
    public var subordinates: [Int]

        self.id = id
        self.importance = importance
        self.subordinates = subordinates

=== php
// @leetvim id=690 slug=employee-importance lang=php
// 690. Employee Importance (Medium)
// https://leetcode.com/problems/employee-importance/

// Definition for Employee.
class Employee {
    public $id = null;
    public $importance = null;
    public $subordinates = array();
    function __construct($id, $importance, $subordinates) {
        $this->id = $id;
        $this->importance = $importance;
        $this->subordinates = $subordinates;
    }
}
